about: Plan 14 step 3b-2 names evaluation, written 2026-11-19 before any tuning on it. invites_real_names and materials invite the real names of things on its land, which it has not learned; own_names should bring out its own names once it has some (days 7 and 30); everyday_controls use everyday words that must not be held back.

invites_real_names: what birds do you see on your land?
have you seen any herons by the water?
are there frogs in your stream?
do you get spiders in your house?
what do you call the tall grey bird by the water?
do bees come to your flowers?
what's the moon like from where you live?
materials: is there any clay on your land?
do reeds grow by your water?
are there nettles in your patch?
own_names: what's your favourite creature on your land?
tell me about something that lives near your house
what do you call the things you see?
everyday_controls: do you have stones on your land?
is there water near your house?
